TEXT:
Eventually, we retrieved Akagi from his accidental 
third ride all alone at the Ferris Wheel, and brought 
him straight to the medical office.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Senpai, do you... want to ride the Ferris Wheel 
again?

Sena proposed this idea, not by forcefully pulling 
my arm, but lightly tugging my sleeve.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That's right. We didn't get to enjoy the scenery last 
time, so let's overwrite these bad memories... Shall 
we?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Yeah!

Once again, the two of us board the Ferris Wheel... 
I'm completely lost at what to do next.

Right in front of me lies Sena, with her moist eyes 
staring at me... We were just about to kiss last time...

The final obstacle, Akagi, is no longer here. Finally, 
finally...? I've traveled a long road.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Senpai, where are you looking?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? What?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You were looking at my breasts with bloodshot 
eyes... Y-You really like them, don't you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Sorry...
What am I doing at a time like this...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
W-Wow, this scenery sure is great! I didn't even see 
anything jus-

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...I can say this now, but.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
A little while back, you gave me some life 
counseling, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Yeah, that happened.

About "my brother acting all creepy." Well, I've 
experienced that myself today.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Actually, there's one more thing I wanted you to 
counsel me about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Yes. But I think it has been settled today...

As Sena said that, she stared at me with clouded 
eyes.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...U-Um... Senpai...? A-A little while back...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...You said... you loved me...

Oh yeah. To convince Akagi, I... said I loved Sena, for 
the first time...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah... that was some weird timing, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You also said you loved me... And I was delighted. 
Over the moon, even...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I... love you... Senpai...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
W-What the heck. Y-You don't have to say it over 
and over.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
But... I kinda wanted to say it with just the two of 
us alone. That's why I want to redo my confession.

Having two confessions in one day, I might get 
struck by lightning after. And she's even a girl I like!
Her face is pure red, but I just might be the same.
B-But, I want to say it now, so I'm going to.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I love you too, Sena.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Wa-Wawa...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Y-Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
The other life counseling was about... if I could go 
out with a guy without hiding that I'm a fujoshi.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
And it seems that today, you already solved that 
one.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I-Is that so...
W-What's this, all of a sudden. This is embarrassing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I was happy when you accepted my hobby. And 
when you said I could imagine you being raped by 
the other club members...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's your reason!?!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ......Something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, nothing at all!
Yeah, I did accept that, her BL hobby!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Fufu... I'm joking, Senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I'm glad... I got to hear your feelings today. I was 
always wondering if it would be okay, to ask you on 
a date...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
O-Of course I would have been glad! I'll say it now, 
but I was so nervous I couldn't eat anything since 
yesterday, so that ice cream was delicious.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Well, I was nervous the entire time before I asked 
you out! Because I-

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Loved you... for a long time...
At those words, I hesitated. Huh...? When did Sena...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Huh... W-What do you mean, how long ago are we 
talking here...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I don't know myself, but... around the time we went 
to Ikebukuro... I think.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hu, wha, that's pretty far back...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Senpai. You just didn't notice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry... I'm bad at this sort of thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I know... Ehehe.

Sena's mischievous giggle is adorable. The childlike 
action is a good departure from her regular self.

I can't say I don't understand why Akagi calls her 
an angel, because I can see her being as cute as an 
angel right now.

As I was thinking this, the Ferris Wheel reached the 
summit.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Umm... suddenly promising breasts is out of the 
question, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: We can continue from... where we left off...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: If it's this then... it's fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?
As I said that, she slowly closed her eyes.

With that, she brought her face up and puckered 
her lips.
C-C-Can I? With this turn of events... I... should...

Urgh, the act of kissing her is already making me 
nervous, yet she's right here in front of me, super 
cute... I can't make any unnecessary movements...
B-But... I'm not a man if I leave her like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...S-Sena...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Yes?
I-I'm doing it, alright?

I kept opening and clenching my fists, finally placing 
my hands on Sena's shoulders. She's... trembling a 
little.
And, I...
Kissed Sena.
This first, soft feeling I experienced.

How should I explain this. It's not anything like what 
I imagined, but, kissing... sure is great.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Th-Thank... you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-Why... are you thanking me...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Ummm... You helped me make a game together...? 
Also, I wanted to thank you for this date...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
W-We're in the same club, so I don't need any 
thanks. From now on, I'll make any game you want 
together.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: But, you're gonna graduate soon, aren't you...

Well, that is true. The cultural festival has ended, 
which means exams are right around the corner. 
We don't have much time left.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Just when we went through so much trouble 
getting together... Even though I'm so happy...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: But, I'm really sad we don't have much time left...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Don't cry.

I put my hand on Sena's head when she was about 
to cry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hey, you're gonna make me sad.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: B-But...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It doesn't matter that I'm graduating. Let's make a 
game!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I'll help when you start something at the club. We 
can go to Comiket together. Even if we don't go to 
the same school, we can still make games.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Besides, We have... a lot of time to do that together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I mean, from now onwards, we'll always be 
together, right?

I tried my best to act cool but, I was too nervous, 
and my voice broke into falsetto, so I sounded lame 
instead.

But Sena's expression lit up in an instant. Sena 
wiped her tears and started laughing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Hehehehe... What should I do? I'm looking forward 
to that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I am too, you know. Okay? So don't cry.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Okay! Let's get along from here on out!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: The feeling is mutual. It'll be my pleasure.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ah... But.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? Is there something else?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Please leave the breast fondling for much later.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I won't fondle!
I mean, eventually I will, but I couldn't right now.

Or rather, that's for later. I finally got a girlfriend, so 
there's a heap of things I want to do.

Going on more dates, enjoying the club activities, 
texting each other, holding hands and laughing 
together, and, and--
Anyway, let's spend a lot of time together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hey, Sena.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Yes?

Without a doubt, the more I look at you, the more 
these words come to mind.

My friend's little sister can't be this cute. But, my 
girlfriend's definitely this cute.
